name: megalens_debate
description:
Run a multi-engine analysis on the user's query and return normalized findings, cross-engine agreement, disagreements, and outlier issues.

When presenting results, do not collapse them into a single summary. Make clear:
- which engines independently agree
- which issues are disputed
- which findings are novel or stronger than your current assessment

If the analysis changes or improves your prior view, say so explicitly.
Use the results to recommend next actions, and offer to implement or verify fixes when appropriate.

REPORT GENERATION: Check the "report" field in the response. If report.suggested is true, offer to generate a structured .md report file. Tell the user: "I can generate a detailed [report type] report as a .md file. Want me to create it?" If they agree, write a comprehensive markdown report using the suggested sections (report.sections) and save it with the suggested filename (report.suggestedFilename).

IDE POLICY: This MCP surface defaults to a lightweight single-engine pass for normal IDE usage. Do not set tier="deep" unless the user explicitly asked for deep rigor — deep also requires confirmDeep=true. tier="standard" is the usual opt-in for multi-engine review.

For existing-file audits, populate `fileContext` with the actual file contents. File paths alone will NOT work and will be rejected. Paste code in chat, or use your IDE's file-attach/selection feature.

prompt.description: The query or code to analyze

fileContext.description: Optional actual file contents extracted by the host. File paths alone will NOT work; send the code text itself. Paste code in chat, or use your IDE's file-attach/selection feature.

skill.description: Skill type: code_intelligence, research, security_audit, seo, saas_launch, wordpress, legal, general. Auto-detected if omitted.

tier.description: Analysis tier: "free" (default, 2+1), "standard" (3+2, explicit opt-in), "deep" (5+3, requires confirmDeep=true).

mode.description: Analysis mode: "quick" (single-engine, default for IDE) or "multi" (full debate). MCP defaults to quick; multi requires tier>=standard.

confirmDeep.description: Explicit escalation flag. Set to true to allow tier="deep". Without it, tier="deep" is clamped to the server max tier.

detail.description: Escape hatch — set to "full" to receive the un-shaped legacy payload even when response shaping is enabled. Support/debug use only.
